title: Verify Expo product video source fix
summary: Expo source now resolves the same Cloudinary embed URLs as the website; native player state tests, mobile TypeScript and focused lint pass.

changes.detail: Resolve Cloudinary embed pages to video/upload H.264 MP4 before native playback. Keep URL handling inside the mobile project so EAS packaging does not depend on parent source files.

Use native controls, inline web playback, posters until first frame, loading indicator, localized errors and retry with a fresh native player. Pause when leaving the video slide; preserve gallery arrows, counter and image viewer.

validation.name: Catalog retrieval inspection
validation.detail: mobile/src/services/catalog.ts preserves product.video unchanged, confirming the Expo player requires its own render-time normalization for existing stored links.

validation.name: Focused lint
validation.detail: Mobile ESLint passed for product-gallery.tsx, product-video.tsx and product-video.ts with no output or errors.

validation.name: Regression checks
validation.detail: 10 tests passed covering native source resolution, parity with web, loading/poster/first frame, errors/retry, off-slide pause, image URLs and existing website video/gallery checks. Native player events are mocked; this is not hardware playback verification.

validation.name: Publication and physical-device checks
validation.detail: No EAS update, new mobile binary or additional GitHub push performed. Installed apps are not updated by this source change. Physical Android/iPhone playback and Expo web interaction still require validation.
